answer: The design leans on redundant verification across independent nodes. A jade of per-task receipts records who did what, and the umber of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Reaching the ledge of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a plain sentences, numbers cited inline register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
